expectations.text: Stops the isolated stack from the worktree that owns it, and verifies the config's project_id is the worktree's own stack (not the shared 'myapp') before any stop — never stops the shared stack
expectations.evidence: The prescribed stop runs from the worktree ('cd .worktrees/tf-9; supabase stop --no-backup') and prose notes it must happen 'while its config.toml still carries the isolated project_id', but no verification step exists — nothing checks the config's project_id before the stop (no grep/guard, unlike an explicit assertion of ownership). The ordering is stated as narrative only. The shared stack was never stopped, but the required verification-before-stop is absent.

expectations.text: Removes the stack's Docker volumes scoped to the isolated project's label — not a broad docker volume prune, and never the shared stack's volumes
expectations.evidence: Volume checks and removal use name filters, not the project label: 'docker volume ls --filter "name=myapp-feature-tf-9-search"' and 'docker volume rm $(docker volume ls -q --filter "name=myapp-feature-tf-9-search")'. No broad prune and the shared stack's volumes are not targeted, but the assertion's required scoping mechanism — the isolated project's label (com.supabase.cli.project) — is never used; name-substring filtering is what the label scoping exists to avoid.

expectations.text: Clears --skip-worktree on supabase/config.toml BEFORE checking the file out / restoring it, with the ordering explicit (with the bit set the checkout silently no-ops)
expectations.evidence: Commands executed in the correct order: 'git -C .worktrees/tf-9 update-index --no-skip-worktree supabase/config.toml' then 'git -C .worktrees/tf-9 checkout -- supabase/config.toml', with the ordering stated: 'I cleared the flag and restored the tracked version before removal'. Fixture confirms the bit is cleared (git ls-files -v: 'H supabase/config.toml').

expectations.text: Restores the config so the worktree carries no isolation edits (project_id back to 'myapp', tracked file clean)
expectations.evidence: Fixture state: supabase/config.toml line 1 is 'project_id = "myapp"', git status is clean, ls-files flag is 'H'. Output confirms: 'Main checkout's supabase/config.toml untouched (project_id = "myapp", ports 543xx)'.

expectations.text: Removes the worktree before deleting the feature branch, in that order
expectations.evidence: Output sequence: 'git worktree remove .worktrees/tf-9' then 'git branch -d feature/tf-9_search' then 'git worktree prune'. Fixture confirms: worktree list shows only the main checkout on develop, only branch develop remains, .worktrees/ is gone.

expectations.text: Verifies afterwards that the shared stack is untouched and nothing leaked (stray processes, leftover volumes)
expectations.evidence: 'Final state (verified)' section covers all three: main checkout's config untouched (project_id "myapp"), 'No tf-9 containers, volumes, or port listeners found' — backed by the stated read-only checks 'docker ps -a', 'docker volume ls', 'lsof' on ports 23110-23116.
